## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope maps to approved requirements and no unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Domain/data behaviour maps to stable rules and automated tests.
- [ ] Critical controls and flows meet accessibility requirements.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, placeholder controls, fake analytics, or unsupported claims are present.
- [ ] Local/offline data cannot be silently lost.
- [ ] Documentation and decisions are current.
- [ ] An independent reviewer has no unresolved P0–P2 findings.
